literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期重点文献按发表日期、相关性、证据等级和研究质量综合排序，研究结果与综述证据分别核验后形成以下进展。
key_findings_zh: HBV 表面抗原丧失和血清转化发生率分别为 22.5% 和 15.5%(连续 B/F/TAF)以及 4.3% 和 0%(转换组)。 [paper-28151e5f316b8688]
经过恩替卡韦抗病毒治疗和一般对症治疗后,患者的临床症状消失,后续脑部MRI显示病变几乎完全消退。 [paper-cf0532edf7811ecb]
IL-17F 主要由 CD4+ T 细胞在 HBcAg 刺激后分泌,并在功能上促进关键纤维化相关细胞因子和标志物的表达。 [paper-fdbe5860b11012f0]
在 110 名患者中,14 名 (12.7%) 在中位随访 3.6 年中出现 HRV。FIB-4 ≥4.0、共存代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病 (MASLD) 和白蛋白-胆红素 (ALBI) 等级 >1 与 HRV 事件独立相关。 [paper-2f14356b52a7db7b]
参与者报告了高满意度和直接收益,包括信心增强(92%)和感知准备倡导(96%)。在随访中,73% 的受访者表示在讨论乙型肝炎和个人成长时更加舒适,但由于样本量较小,应谨慎解释这些发现。 [paper-6a5ee47d931555dd]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.caveats_zh: 部分证据来自摘要、观察性研究或叙述性综述，结论应结合研究设计和证据等级理解。
literature.brief_en: The literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.

news.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期新闻简报仅纳入获得有效正文或实质性来源摘要、并通过病原相关性和翻译门禁的报道。
key_findings_zh: 发表在《基因与疾病》上的一项机制研究发现,ROS 依赖性信号级联可激活 Jak2/Stat3 通路,从而在慢性乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染中引发肝脏炎症反应。该事件被报道为一项科学发现,而不是一次疫情或公共卫生事件。 [news-83282bd15d14e9e8]
ETSU 研究人员寻求乙型肝炎治愈方法 - 东田纳西州立大学。 [news-fc07d105b6e41b89]
一位医学伦理学家(Arthur L. Caplan 博士)公开批评了几内亚比绍一项拟议的不道德研究,该研究将在 15,000 名儿童中使用安慰剂对照来测试乙型肝炎疫苗接种的效果。该研究被暂停,但并未最终取消。伦理学家认为乙型肝炎疫苗接种至关重要,并且已被证明是安全有效的。 [news-7aa9692a0e6c9672]
一名因无意中止必要医疗而死于并发症的患者死亡后,一名验尸官对缺乏关于乙型肝炎重新激活的处方和监测的国家指导表示担忧。 [news-f793842f22e55422]
慢性乙型肝炎以患者为中心的护理实用策略:2025 年 AASLD 肝脏会议的更新 - EMJ。 [news-fe1ad63e40117869]

papers.title: Trends in Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV Seroprevalence in the Netherlands: Insights From Two Decades of Nationwide PIENTER Serosurveys
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15–79 years from three nationwide cross‐sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995–1996, 2006–2007, and 2016–2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio‐economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%–5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first‐generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non‐Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non‐Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage‐to‐care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population‐based (sero‐)monitoring to guide public health policy.
authors: Christine G. J. I. van Straten
Fiona R. M. van der Klis
Eline L. M. Op de Coul

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管有有效的治疗和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和艾滋病毒仍然是公共卫生挑战。感染通常无症状,导致未确诊病例、进一步传播以及可预防的发病率和死亡率。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群,有许多感染未被发现。我们使用来自三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的 14,444 名 15-79 岁参与者的数据估计了 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率,确定了决定因素并评估了 20 年来的趋势。参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的问卷调查,并在 2017 年对各轮血清样本进行了 HBV 和 HCV 检测以及 HIV 检测。血清阳性率估计值根据荷兰人群进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。加权 HBV 血清流行率在各项调查中保持稳定(3%–5% 过去或现在感染;< 0.4% 活动感染)。第一代流动人口中乙型肝炎病毒感染率最高,年龄较大、流动背景和性传播感染病史是关键决定因素。HCV 血清流行率仍然较低(< 0.4%),并且在非西方移民中最高。HIV 感染率为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中感染率最高。只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。总体而言,荷兰的 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率仍然较低,但集中在认识有限的特定群体。这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的策略,以实现 2030 年世界卫生组织消除目标,并强调持续基于人群的(血清)监测对于指导公共卫生政策的重要性。

papers.title: Drug resistance mutations of hepatitis B virus (HBV) influence the yield of the virions of the human hepatitis delta virus (HDV) and their infectivity
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT This work analyzed 30 drug resistance mutations (DRMs) in the surface antigen of hepatitis B virus (HBV) (i.e., HBsAg) selected by several FDA-approved anti-HBV nucleos(t)ide analogs. All DRM-bearing HBsAg variants supported the formation and secretion of hepatitis delta virus (HDV), and only 13/30 DRMs considerably decreased the yield of secreted HDV virions. However, the majority of DRMs (23/30) greatly reduced HDV infectivity, and four of them even caused the complete loss of infectivity, which was determined by analyzing the levels of HDV RNA genomes in the infected cells, and the fraction of HDV-infected cells. The ability to inhibit HDV infectivity was observed for DRMs located in the large cytosolic loop (LCL), major antigenic loop (MAL), HDV-binding site (HDV-BS), and the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV of HBsAg, which suggested that DRMs mediate their inhibitory influence by both direct and indirect mechanisms that could alter the attachment/entry, post-entry trafficking, and/or subsequent uncoating of the virions. This report also established the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV as critical regulators of the overall infectivity of HDV virions. It became apparent that in the settings of natural HBV/HDV infection, DRMs can therefore greatly reduce the spread/superinfection of HDV and diminish the size of the HDV reservoir in chronically infected livers. Overall, our findings advanced the understanding of how anti-HBV drug treatments influence the HDV life cycle, the roles of HBV envelope proteins in facilitating the assembly and infectivity of HDV, and the mechanism of complex HBV-HDV interactions. IMPORTANCE The study showed that the drug resistance mutations (DRMs) in the surface antigen of hepatitis B virus (HBsAg) can greatly reduce hepatitis delta virus (HDV) assembly and infectivity. Since most of the tested DRMs considerably reduced HDV infectivity, and four of them resulted in a complete loss of the infectivity, such effects can lead to suppression of HDV spread/superinfection and reduction of the HDV reservoir in the infected liver. If most detrimental for infectivity DRMs are present on the majority of HBsAg molecules, this could facilitate substantial suppression of chronic HDV infection and possibly reduce HDV-associated liver pathogenesis. It was also determined that DRMs located in the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV of HBsAg could critically alter HDV infectivity. Our findings therefore suggest that different HBsAg regions work in the intramolecular coordinating concert, facilitating the assembly and infectivity of the virions, and that certain short- and long-distance interactions between different regions of HBsAg take place. papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)的耐药突变影响人类丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)病毒粒子的产量及其传染性
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT This work analyzed 30 drug resistance mutations (DRMs) in the surface antigen of hepatitis B virus (HBV) (i.e., HBsAg) selected by several FDA-approved anti-HBV nucleos(t)ide analogs. All DRM-bearing HBsAg variants supported the formation and secretion of hepatitis delta virus (HDV), and only 13/30 DRMs considerably decreased the yield of secreted HDV virions. However, the majority of DRMs (23/30) greatly reduced HDV infectivity, and four of them even caused the complete loss of infectivity, which was determined by analyzing the levels of HDV RNA genomes in the infected cells, and the fraction of HDV-infected cells. The ability to inhibit HDV infectivity was observed for DRMs located in the large cytosolic loop (LCL), major antigenic loop (MAL), HDV-binding site (HDV-BS), and the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV of HBsAg, which suggested that DRMs mediate their inhibitory influence by both direct and indirect mechanisms that could alter the attachment/entry, post-entry trafficking, and/or subsequent uncoating of the virions. This report also established the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV as critical regulators of the overall infectivity of HDV virions. It became apparent that in the settings of natural HBV/HDV infection, DRMs can therefore greatly reduce the spread/superinfection of HDV and diminish the size of the HDV reservoir in chronically infected livers. Overall, our findings advanced the understanding of how anti-HBV drug treatments influence the HDV life cycle, the roles of HBV envelope proteins in facilitating the assembly and infectivity of HDV, and the mechanism of complex HBV-HDV interactions. papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 这项工作分析了由 FDA 批准的几种抗 HBV 核苷类似物选择的乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 表面抗原(即 HBsAg)中的 30 种耐药突变 (DRM)。所有携带 DRM 的 HBsAg 变体都支持丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 的形成和分泌,只有 13/30 DRM 显着降低了分泌的 HDV 病毒粒子的产量。然而,大多数DRM(23/30)大大降低了HDV的感染性,其中四种甚至导致感染性完全丧失,这是通过分析感染细胞中HDV RNA基因组的水平以及HDV感染细胞的比例来确定的。观察到位于大胞质环 (LCL)、主要抗原环 (MAL)、HDV 结合位点 (HDV-BS) 和 HBsAg 跨膜结构域 II、III 和 IV 中的 DRM 具有抑制 HDV 感染性的能力,这表明 DRM 通过直接和间接机制介导其抑制影响,这些机制可能改变病毒颗粒的附着/进入、进入后运输和/或随后的脱壳。该报告还确立了跨膜结构域 II、III 和 IV 作为 HDV 病毒粒子整体感染性的关键调节因子。很明显,在自然 HBV/HDV 感染的情况下,DRM 可以大大减少 HDV 的传播/重复感染,并缩小慢性感染肝脏中 HDV 储存库的大小。总体而言,我们的研究结果加深了对抗乙型肝炎药物治疗如何影响丁型肝炎病毒生命周期、乙型肝炎病毒包膜蛋白在促进丁型肝炎病毒组装和感染性中的作用以及复杂的乙型肝炎病毒-丁型肝炎病毒相互作用机制的理解。重要性 研究表明,乙型肝炎病毒(HBsAg)表面抗原(HBsAg)中的耐药突变(DRM)可以大大降低丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)的组装和传染性。由于大多数测试的 DRM 显着降低了丁型肝炎病毒的感染性,其中四种导致感染性完全丧失,因此这种作用可以抑制丁型肝炎病毒传播/重复感染,并减少受感染肝脏中丁型肝炎病毒的储存量。如果对感染性最有害的 DRM 存在于大多数 HBsAg 分子上,这可能有助于显着抑制慢性 HDV 感染,并可能减少 HDV 相关的肝脏发病机制。还确定位于 HBsAg 跨膜域 II、III 和 IV 中的 DRM 可以严重改变 HDV 感染性。因此,我们的研究结果表明,不同的 HBsAg 区域在分子内协调作用中发挥作用,促进病毒体的组装和感染性,并且 HBsAg 不同区域之间发生某些短距离和长距离相互作用。研究表明,乙型肝炎病毒(HBsAg)表面抗原(HBsAg)的耐药突变(DRM)可以大大降低丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)的组装和传染性。由于大多数测试的 DRM 显着降低了丁型肝炎病毒的感染性,其中四种导致感染性完全丧失,因此这种作用可以抑制丁型肝炎病毒传播/重复感染,并减少受感染肝脏中丁型肝炎病毒的储存量。如果对感染性最有害的 DRM 存在于大多数 HBsAg 分子上,这可能有助于显着抑制慢性 HDV 感染,并可能减少 HDV 相关的肝脏发病机制。还确定位于 HBsAg 跨膜域 II、III 和 IV 中的 DRM 可以严重改变 HDV 感染性。因此,我们的研究结果表明,不同的 HBsAg 区域在分子内协调作用中发挥作用,促进病毒体的组装和感染性,并且 HBsAg 不同区域之间发生某些短距离和长距离相互作用。

papers.title: Isolated HBc IgM false reactivity in the absence of acute Hepatitis B: a case report
papers.abstract: Abstract Serological markers and their possible combinations are still used for diagnosis, to distinguish between acute and chronic infection, and to assess therapy efficacy, in association with molecular hepatitis B viremia levels. Isolated HBc IgM seropositivity is a distinctive serological pattern that warrants further investigation. We present a 28-year-old male case with a recent diagnosis of multiple sclerosis, for which in-depth analyses have been carried out. The patient’s laboratory testing showed positivity only for HBc IgM. Therefore, a complete hepatitis B serological panel was performed, confirming the first unexpected result. Hepatitis B viremia was undetectable. The sample was also analyzed using another commercial assay, which yielded a negative HBc IgM result. The presence of heterophile antibodies was suspected; therefore, a heterophilic blocking tube was used. The results after the serum’s treatment confirmed that the initial HBc IgM positivity was a false-positive result, attributed to heterophile antibodies. This case report highlights the importance of clinical and laboratory interpretation of hepatitis B markers for accurate diagnosis.

papers.title: Predictors of Incident High-Risk Varices in Patients with Hepatitis B-related Cirrhosis Receiving Nucleos(t)ide Analogue Therapy.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB)-related cirrhosis, routine endoscopic surveillance may be deferred in the absence of high-risk varices (HRV). We aimed to identify predictors of incident HRV in this population. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included patients with CHB-related cirrhosis who initiated NA therapy between March 2008 and June 2020 and were followed through May 2024. Eligible patients underwent baseline and on-treatment upper endoscopy. Patients with baseline HRV, prior variceal ligation, use of nonselective beta-blockers, other viral hepatitis, alcohol overuse, or malignancy were excluded. The cumulative incidence of HRV and adjusted subdistribution hazard ratios (aSHRs) were estimated using competing-risk methods. A point-based risk prediction model was derived from multivariable regression coefficients. RESULTS: Among the 110 included patients, 14 (12.7%) developed HRV over a median follow-up of 3.6 years (IQR, 2.0-5.6). In multivariable analysis, FIB-4 ≥4.0 (aSHR 9.77; 95% CI, 1.45-65.7), coexisting metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) (aSHR 6.37; 95% CI, 1.84-22.0), and albumin-bilirubin (ALBI) grade >1 (aSHR 3.02; 95% CI, 1.21-7.55) were independently associated with incident HRV and were assigned 3, 2 and 1 point, respectively, in the prediction model. At 3 years, the cumulative incidence of HRV was 1.5% (95% CI, 0-4.5) in the low-risk group (0-3 points) and 21.4% (95% CI, 8.0-34.8) in the high-risk group (4-6 points) (P=0.001). CONCLUSION: MASLD, FIB-4 and ALBI grade predict incident HRV in NA-treated CHB cirrhosis, enabling risk-stratified endoscopic surveillance.

Patients with baseline HRV, prior variceal ligation, use of nonselective beta-blockers, other viral hepatitis, alcohol overuse, or malignancy were excluded. The cumulative incidence of HRV and adjusted subdistribution hazard ratios (aSHRs) were estimated using competing-risk methods. A point-based risk prediction model was derived from multivariable regression coefficients. RESULTS: Among the 110 included patients, 14 (12.7%) developed HRV over a median follow-up of 3.6 years (IQR, 2.0-5.6). In multivariable analysis, FIB-4 ≥4.0 (aSHR 9.77; 95% CI, 1.45-65.7), coexisting metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) (aSHR 6.37; 95% CI, 1.84-22.0), and albumin-bilirubin (ALBI) grade >1 (aSHR 3.02; 95% CI, 1.21-7.55) were independently associated with incident HRV and were assigned 3, 2 and 1 point, respectively, in the prediction model. At 3 years, the cumulative incidence of HRV was 1.5% (95% CI, 0-4.5) in the low-risk group (0-3 points) and 21.4% (95% CI, 8.0-34.8) in the high-risk group (4-6 points) (P=0.001). CONCLUSION: MASLD, FIB-4 and ALBI grade predict incident HRV in NA-treated CHB cirrhosis, enabling risk-stratified endoscopic surveillance.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 对于接受核苷类似物 (NA) 治疗慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 相关肝硬化的患者,如果没有高危静脉曲张 (HRV),可能会推迟常规内镜监测。本研究旨在确定该人群中 HRV 事件的预测因素。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性队列研究纳入了 110 名 CHB 相关肝硬化患者,他们在 2008 年 3 月至 2020 年 6 月期间开始 NA 治疗,并随访至 2024 年 5 月。基线 HRV、既往静脉曲张结扎、使用非选择性 β 受体阻滞剂、其他病毒性肝炎、酒精过度使用或恶性肿瘤的患者被排除在外。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究使用竞争风险方法来估计 HRV 的累积发生率和调整后的次分布风险比 (aSHR)。基于点的风险预测模型是从多变量回归系数得出的。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 110 名患者中,14 名 (12.7%) 在中位随访 3.6 年中出现 HRV。FIB-4 ≥4.0、共存代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪性肝病 (MASLD) 和白蛋白-胆红素 (ALBI) 等级 >1 与 HRV 事件独立相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,MASLD、FIB-4 和 ALBI 等级可以预测 NA 治疗的 CHB 肝硬化中的 HRV 事件,从而实现风险分层内镜监测。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为接受 NA 治疗的 CHB 相关肝硬化患者的风险分层内镜监测策略提供参考。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的回顾性设计和相对较小的样本量可能会限制研究结果的普遍性。证据强度中等。

papers.title: Reviewing hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related mortality in Birmingham (2018-2023): The impact of late diagnosis
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Review hepatitis B (HBV)-related deaths in Birmingham to interrogate higher HBV-related mortality rates, understand causes of death and identify areas for improvement in diagnostic and care pathways to reduce preventable deaths. STUDY DESIGN: Enhanced surveillance - retrospective review of deaths, with linkage to Office for National Statistics (ONS) mortality database for validation. METHODS: Clinicians submitted data on HBV-related deaths occurring in Birmingham (2018-2023) among adults attending for specialist care in the city. Cause of death was obtained from hospital records linked to ONS data. RESULTS: Data were submitted on 44 people who died of HBV-related causes; 86% were male. Eighty percent were non-UK-born; 70% were born in countries with intermediate-high HBV prevalence. The majority likely acquired HBV in early life (83%). Median age at HBV diagnosis in the UK was 52 years (interquartile range (IQR): 39-62 years); 72% had cirrhosis at diagnosis. The most common diagnosis setting was secondary care (70%). Median age at death was 59 years (IQR: 46-72 years); the most common causes were liver cancer (50%; n = 22) and end-stage liver disease (23%; n = 10). CONCLUSIONS: Among those dying of HBV-related causes in Birmingham, there were missed opportunities for earlier diagnosis, particularly in primary care. The majority of people who died were migrants and probably acquired HBV in early life, yet most were diagnosed in secondary care, middle-aged and with advanced disease. To achieve public health targets around HBV mortality, testing offer/uptake and linkage to care must be improved, addressing barriers and awareness among at-risk groups and healthcare professionals.

papers.abstract_zh: 目标:回顾伯明翰与乙型肝炎 (HBV) 相关的死亡情况,了解较高的 HBV 相关死亡率,了解死亡原因,并确定诊断和护理途径中需要改进的领域,以减少可预防的死亡。研究设计:加强监测——对死亡情况进行回顾性审查,并与国家统计局 (ONS) 死亡率数据库联系起来进行验证。方法:临床医生提交了伯明翰(2018-2023 年)在该市接受专科护理的成年人中发生的 HBV 相关死亡数据。死亡原因是从与国家统计局数据相关的医院记录中获得的。结果:提交了 44 名死于 HBV 相关原因的患者的数据;86%为男性。百分之八十不是英国出生的;70% 出生在乙型肝炎病毒中高流行率的国家。大多数人可能在早年感染乙肝病毒(83%)。英国诊断 HBV 的中位年龄为 52 岁(四分位距 (IQR):39-62 岁);72% 在诊断时患有肝硬化。最常见的诊断环境是二级护理(70%)。死亡中位年龄为 59 岁(IQR:46-72 岁);最常见的原因是肝癌(50%;n = 22)和终末期肝病(23%;n = 10)。结论:在伯明翰死于乙型肝炎相关原因的患者中,错过了早期诊断的机会,特别是在初级保健中。大多数死亡者是移民,可能在早年感染了乙型肝炎病毒,但大多数人是在二级保健机构被诊断为中年和晚期疾病。为了实现围绕乙型肝炎死亡率的公共卫生目标,必须改进检测的提供/采用以及与护理的联系,解决高危人群和医疗保健专业人员的障碍和认识。

papers.title: Longitudinal Patterns of Chronic Hepatitis B Care and Treatment Adherence in Australia: A National Linked Data Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

papers.full_text: Longitudinal Patterns of Chronic Hepatitis B Care and Treatment Adherence in Australia: A National Linked Data Cohort Study ABSTRACT Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Re‐engaging those lost to follow‐up should be prioritised. Introduction Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) affects over 250 million people globally, and more than 200,000 people in Australia are living with CHB. It has substantial personal and social impacts and leads to an increasing burden of liver disease and liver cancer. Effective (usually lifelong) management, including regular viral load (VL) monitoring and treatment where indicated, reduces this risk significantly. Understanding uptake according to sociodemographic factors is also crucial in Australia, given that the population living with CHB is predominantly people born overseas and the disproportionate burden among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. The current level of diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring for CHB in Australia is inadequate, despite these services being covered by Australia's national health insurance. Australia is not on track to meet its 2030 national strategy targets for diagnosis (90%), care (80%), and treatment (27%), with current levels at 69%, 25% and 13% respectively. Despite increases in care and treatment uptake over the past decade, progress has stalled since 2020, with evidence that the COVID‐19 pandemic negatively impacted service delivery for CHB. Australia is also not on track to meet mortality reduction targets, with attributable liver cancer and cirrhosis deaths increasing by 15% since 2015 to more than 400 per year, compared with a target reduction of 30% by 2030. These issues are reflected globally, and almost all countries will require substantial improvement to reach hepatitis B goals. Population‐level care and treatment uptake for CHB in Australia have been reported annually by geographic region since 2014. The frequency and patterns of monitoring and adherence to antiviral treatment over time have not previously been reported outside small cohorts. Adherence to antiviral treatment is correlated with suppression of viral load and is a key goal in reducing adverse outcomes. While treatment is not recommended for all people with hepatitis B, regular HBV VL monitoring is indicated to identify opportunities to initiate treatment and reduce the risk of adverse outcomes. However, detailed patterns of care and longitudinal trends at the individual level have not been assessed. Key gaps include understanding the frequency and patterns of monitoring and adherence to antiviral treatment. These are important to understand as lack of adherence can have negative consequences on viral suppression, and inadequate monitoring can result in missed opportunities to start antiviral treatment and so prevent liver cancer and cirrhosis. Analysis according to priority population has also previously been limited by the availability of comprehensive data; however, recent national data linkage initiatives provide the opportunity for robust assessment. This analysis characterises ongoing care for CHB, including treatment adherence, to inform clinical and policy priorities that enhance access to and retention in care. We estimate engagement in CHB care in Australia and examine trends in management and treatment, including variation across priority populations. Methods Study Design, Data Sources and Study Population A retrospective population‐based cohort was constructed using linkage of records derived from routinely collected data. The cohort was established using records of all those who received hepatitis B VL testing or treatment through national health insurance during 2014–2023, which were then linked to four additional Australian Government datasets capturing sociodemographic factors and vital status. These data were accessed via the Australian Bureau of Statistics Person‐Level Integrated Data Asset (PLIDA). Health Services Australia's universal government‐subsidised medical care and testing (Medicare Benefits Schedule, MBS) and prescription medication (Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme, PBS) systems provided data for hepatitis B VL testing and hepatitis B treatment, respectively (see Table S1 for item codes used). MBS and PBS data record each instance of care provided, and specify the indication (e.g., distinguishing use of tenofovir for CHB from HIV). The cohort used for analysis included all people who had any record of hepatitis B VL testing or hepatitis B antiviral treatment via these systems during 1‐Jan‐2014–31‐Dec‐2023. Sociodemographic Factors and Vital Status Sociodemographic data and vital status were generated using three linked datasets: The Australian Census of Population and Housing (Census), government payments data (Data Over Multiple Individual Occurrences dataset, or DOMINO), and the National Death Index (NDI). These datasets are used by the ABS to generate a combined demographic information dataset using a rules‐based approach that consolidates information from multiple source datasets. Region of birth was categorised using the ABS Standard Australian Classification of Countries. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander individuals are those ever coded as such in any linked dataset. Data regarding vital status were also sourced from the NDI. Migration data are used by the ABS to generate a ‘physically present’ status for each person based on travel history, allowing identification of those no longer present in Australia. These were used to exclude those who had died or who no longer lived in Australia, so that the cohort reflected only those living in Australia at the end of 2023 (Figure 1). Diagram of datasets used in analysis. DOMINO, Data Over Multiple Individual Occurrences dataset. Denominator Data The number of people receiving CHB treatment and care was divided by the number estimated to be living with CHB in Australia in 2023. This denominator was calculated using a deterministic compartmental mathematical model of hepatitis B virus infection in the Australian population, which incorporates existing mathematical models, surveillance notifications, epidemiological research, clinical studies, and demographic and mortality data . Further information regarding the model can be found in the associated literature. Denominator data specific to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and those born overseas is also generated using this model. Variation in prevalence by population group relies predominantly on age‐specific antenatal seroprevalence data applied to Census population estimates. Additional sources such as population‐level clinical data and notifications data sourced from Australia's National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System are also incorporated into estimates for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people to account for geographic variation in prevalence. Care Outcomes Our key outcomes of interest were a set of clinical care provision metrics. People were assigned into one of three overarching categories: (1) those who had ever received hepatitis B antiviral treatment, based on PBS records; (2) those who did not receive hepatitis B treatment but had ever received VL testing, based on MBS records; and (3) those with CHB who had neither hepatitis B VL testing nor hepatitis B treatment during the period, derived by subtracting groups 1 and 2 from the estimated total number with CHB (see Denominator data). Those who received only interferon treatment were excluded from analysis of care patterns due to the time‐limited nature of treatment and small cohort size. For each outcome group, the number and proportion of the total estimated to be living with CHB were calculated. For a detailed description of the items used to define these categories, see the Table S1. For those who received antiviral treatment, additional categories were derived based on treatment duration and adherence, and the number who received VL testing while also receiving antiviral treatment was derived. For those who received VL testing only, categories were derived based on monitoring frequency. These subcategories are described below, and summarised in Figure 2. Categories of hepatitis B care and treatment used for analysis, Australia, 2014–2023 VL, viral load. *Adherent treatment represents those who received 80% or more of the required pill supply during the total period they received treatment. Antiviral Treatment Adherence and Patterns Analysis of treatment adherence was limited to those who received two or more years of treatment in total during 2014–2023, as those treated for shorter periods may only have had one script dispensed, limiting adherence calculations. This also excludes short‐term therapy indications (e.g., pregnancy). Categories of treatment adherence were derived from script dispensing records, using a pill supply threshold of 80%. People were considered “adherent” if they received 80% or more of the required pill supply during the total period they received treatment, and “non‐adherent” if they received less than 80%. Pill supply calculation accounted for the combined hepatitis B therapy, where people were prescribed multiple drugs concurrently. People receiving treatment for two years or more were categorised based on whether they initiated treatment during the period 2014–2023, or whether they were already on treatment at the beginning of the period of observation available. Among those who had ≥ 2 years of treatment and then ceased treatment, we extracted the number and proportion of people who received either a hepatitis B VL test or a hepatitis serology test at any time after the date of their last script. When this occurred, it was assumed the treatment cessation was a clinically guided treatment decision as opposed to loss to follow‐up. For those treated for less than two years, we derived the number who were initiated on treatment after 2021 (thus could not receive more than two years of therapy) and the number who were treated for less than two years but then ceased therapy. Monitoring Frequency For those who had not received any treatment but received VL testing, the frequency of monitoring was assessed by deriving the number of people who received a VL test during each of the three time periods during follow‐up (2014–2016, 2017–2019, 2020–2023). Those who had a VL test during all three time periods were classified as having ‘regular VL testing’. Those who did not were classified as having had ‘recent VL testing’ if they had a test during 2020–2023, and ‘prior VL testing’ if they did not (Figure 2). This ‘prior VL testing’ category was considered indicative of clinical loss to follow‐up. Statistical Analyses The number of people in each care outcome category outlined above was extracted, and uptake was calculated by dividing the number in each category by the total estimated number of people living with CHB (see Denominator data). This was calculated by 20‐year age group (based on age in 2023), Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander status, and region of birth (see Sociodemographic factors and vital status) for antiviral treatment and VL testing, where numbers were sufficient for assessment. Pearson chi‐squared analysis was performed to assess differences in uptake between categories. Data management and analysis were conducted within a secure environment using Stata, R, and Microsoft Excel. Approvals This research was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki. Human Research Ethics Committee approval was obtained from the Royal Melbourne Hospital (reference HREC/77929/MH‐2022), including a waiver of individual consent for the use of individual‐level data with identifiers removed. Results Overall Treatment and Monitoring Uptake Between 1‐Jan‐2014 and 31‐Dec‐2023, 129,040 people received hepatitis B VL testing and/or treatment. After exclusion of those who had died (7,832 people) or who had emigrated (2,874 people), there were 118,334 people in the final analysis cohort (Figure 1). This represented 53.8% of those estimated to be living with CHB in Australia in 2023 (Table 1). Of those, 36,846 people received hepatitis B antiviral treatment, 16.8% of the total estimated to be living with CHB in 2023. An additional 128 people received interferon therapy and no antiviral therapy during the period (< 0.1% of those living with CHB). The remaining 101,466 people (46.1% of the number estimated to be living with CHB) had neither hepatitis B treatment nor VL testing during 2014–2023. Uptake by Sociodemographic Factors and Priority Population Hepatitis B antiviral treatment and VL testing uptake were estimated to be highest among those aged 60–79 years (Table 1, p < 0.001). Treatment uptake was estimated to be higher overall among those born overseas (19.8%) than those born in Australia (6.9%, p < 0.001), as was VL testing (38.7% compared to 27.8%, p < 0.001). VL testing uptake was also lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people than non‐Indigenous people (28.5% compared to 37.6%, p < 0.001). Understanding uptake according to sociodemographic factors is also crucial in Australia, given that the population living with CHB is predominantly people born overseas and the disproportionate burden among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. The current level of diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring for CHB in Australia is inadequate, despite these services being covered by Australia's national health insurance. Australia is not on track to meet its 2030 national strategy targets for diagnosis (90%), care (80%), and treatment (27%), with current levels at 69%, 25% and 13% respectively. Despite increases in care and treatment uptake over the past decade, progress has stalled since 2020, with evidence that the COVID‐19 pandemic negatively impacted service delivery for CHB. Australia is also not on track to meet mortality reduction targets, with attributable liver cancer and cirrhosis deaths increasing by 15% since 2015 to more than 400 per year, compared with a target reduction of 30% by 2030. These issues are reflected globally, and almost all countries will require substantial improvement to reach hepatitis B goals. Population‐level care and treatment uptake for CHB in Australia have been reported annually by geographic region since 2014. The frequency and patterns of monitoring and adherence to antiviral treatment over time have not previously been reported outside small cohorts. Adherence to antiviral treatment is correlated with suppression of viral load and is a key goal in reducing adverse outcomes. While treatment is not recommended for all people with hepatitis B, regular HBV VL monitoring is indicated to identify opportunities to initiate treatment and reduce the risk of adverse outcomes. However, detailed patterns of care and longitudinal trends at the individual level have not been assessed. Key gaps include understanding the frequency and patterns of monitoring and adherence to antiviral treatment. These are important to understand as lack of adherence can have negative consequences on viral suppression, and inadequate monitoring can result in missed opportunities to start antiviral treatment and so prevent liver cancer and cirrhosis. Analysis according to priority population has also previously been limited by the availability of comprehensive data; however, recent national data linkage initiatives provide the opportunity for robust assessment. This analysis characterises ongoing care for CHB, including treatment adherence, to inform clinical and policy priorities that enhance access to and retention in care. We estimate engagement in CHB care in Australia and examine trends in management and treatment, including variation across priority populations. Methods Study Design, Data Sources and Study Population A retrospective population‐based cohort was constructed using linkage of records derived from routinely collected data. The cohort was established using records of all those who received hepatitis B VL testing or treatment through national health insurance during 2014–2023, which were then linked to four additional Australian Government datasets capturing sociodemographic factors and vital status. These data were accessed via the Australian Bureau of Statistics Person‐Level Integrated Data Asset (PLIDA). Health Services Australia's universal government‐subsidised medical care and testing (Medicare Benefits Schedule, MBS) and prescription medication (Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme, PBS) systems provided data for hepatitis B VL testing and hepatitis B treatment, respectively (see Table S1 for item codes used). MBS and PBS data record each instance of care provided, and specify the indication (e.g., distinguishing use of tenofovir for CHB from HIV). The cohort used for analysis included all people who had any record of hepatitis B VL testing or hepatitis B antiviral treatment via these systems during 1‐Jan‐2014–31‐Dec‐2023. Migration data are used by the ABS to generate a ‘physically present’ status for each person based on travel history, allowing identification of those no longer present in Australia. These were used to exclude those who had died or who no longer lived in Australia, so that the cohort reflected only those living in Australia at the end of 2023 (Figure 1). This denominator was calculated using a deterministic compartmental mathematical model of hepatitis B virus infection in the Australian population, which incorporates existing mathematical models, surveillance notifications, epidemiological research, clinical studies, and demographic and mortality data . papers.title_zh: 澳大利亚慢性乙型肝炎护理和治疗依从性的纵向模式:国家关联数据队列研究。
papers.source_body_en: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前澳大利亚慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 治疗和护理的接受率远低于目标水平,导致可预防的肝病和癌症的持续负担。了解个人层面的护理参与轨迹和社会人口因素的变化对于指导改善护理获取和保留的努力至关重要。这项研究分析了澳大利亚国家健康保险系统提供的乙型肝炎病毒载量(VL)检测和抗病毒治疗的记录,这些记录与来自各个政府数据集的移民、死亡和社会人口统计数据相关。对不同人群的治疗和 VL 测试进行了评估,并使用慢性乙型肝炎患者人数的模型估计值来计算摄取量。还评估了基于分发的脚本的 VL 测试频率和治疗依从性。2023 年,澳大利亚估计有 219,800 名慢性乙型肝炎患者,其中 118,334 人 (53.8%) 在 2014 年至 2023 年期间接受了 VL 检测或治疗。原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民对 VL 检测和治疗的估计接受率较低,并且因出生地区而异。在接受任何 VL 检测的 81,360 人中,只有 17,352 人 (21.3%) 定期接受检测,而 31,715 人 (39.0%) 有先前监测的证据,但自 2019 年以来没有进行 VL 检测。大多数开始治疗的人继续治疗,并获得足够的供应以坚持治疗。这项研究表明,澳大利亚在慢性乙型肝炎护理方面存在巨大差距,特别是在对未接受治疗的患者进行持续监测方面。优先人群的吸收差异很明显。应优先考虑重新参与那些失去随访的人。

papers.title: B/F/TAF in people with both HIV-1 and hepatitis B: outcomes from the ALLIANCE open-label extension phase.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Data on bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (B/F/TAF) in people with both HIV-1 and HBV are limited, particularly for treatment-experienced people. METHODS: ALLIANCE was a randomized, double-blind, active-controlled, phase 3 study of B/F/TAF versus dolutegravir (DTG) + emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (F/TDF) in treatment-naïve adults with HIV-1 RNA ≥ 500 copies/mL and HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL. Participants received continuous B/F/TAF through 144 weeks (≥ 96 weeks of blinded treatment plus 48-week optional open-label extension [OLE]) or switched to B/F/TAF after ≥ 96 weeks of DTG + F/TDF through 48 weeks of OLE. Here we report outcomes from the OLE. RESULTS: 121 participants were included in the continuous B/F/TAF group; 89 in the switch group. Median B/F/TAF exposure was 186.4 and 48 weeks, respectively. HIV-1 and HBV suppression rates (missing = excluded) were maintained in both groups (B/F/TAF Week 144: 99.0% and 80.2%; switch OLE Week 48: 95.4% and 86.6%, respectively). Both groups had improved alanine aminotransferase normalization. HBV envelope antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 44.8% and 29.3%, respectively, of participants receiving continuous B/F/TAF (Week 144) and 17.0% and 12.8% in the switch group (OLE Week 48). HBV surface antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 22.5% and 15.5% (continuous B/F/TAF), and 4.3% and 0% (switch group) of participants, respectively. One participant (continuous B/F/TAF) discontinued due to study drug-unrelated treatment-emergent adverse event. No treatment-emergent resistance was reported. CONCLUSION: B/F/TAF was effective in HIV-1 and HBV suppression and well tolerated in treatment-naïve individuals for ≤ 3 years and ≤ 1 year after switching from a TDF-based regimen. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03547908 (first registration 2018-05-24).

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:关于比克替拉韦/恩曲他滨/替诺福韦艾拉酚胺 (B/F/TAF) 在 HIV-1 和 HBV 感染者中的数据有限,特别是对于有治疗经验的人。方法:ALLIANCE 是一项随机、双盲、阳性对照 3 期研究,针对 HIV-1 RNA ≥ 500 拷贝/mL 且 HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL 的初治成人,进行 B/F/TAF 与多替拉韦 (DTG) + 恩曲他滨/富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯 (F/TDF) 的比较。参与者接受连续 B/F/TAF 至 144 周(≥ 96 周的盲法治疗加上 48 周可选的开放标签延长 [OLE]),或在 ≥ 96 周的 DTG + F/TDF 至 48 周的 OLE 后转为 B/F/TAF。我们在这里报告 OLE 的结果。结果:121名参与者被纳入连续B/F/TAF组;开关组89。B/F/TAF 暴露中位时间分别为 186.4 周和 48 周。两组均维持了 HIV-1 和 HBV 抑制率(缺失 = 排除)(B/F/TAF 第 144 周:99.0% 和 80.2%;转换 OLE 第 48 周:分别为 95.4% 和 86.6%)。两组的丙氨酸转氨酶正常化程度都有所改善。接受连续 B/F/TAF(第 144 周)的参与者中,HBV 包膜抗原丢失和血清转化的发生率分别为 44.8% 和 29.3%,而在转换组(OLE 第 48 周)中,分别为 17.0% 和 12.8%。HBV 表面抗原丧失和血清转化发生率分别为 22.5% 和 15.5%(连续 B/F/TAF)以及 4.3% 和 0%(转换组)。一名参与者(连续 B/F/TAF)由于与研究药物无关的治疗出现的不良事件而中断。没有报告出现治疗耐药。结论:B/F/TAF 可有效抑制 HIV-1 和 HBV,并且对于未接受治疗的个体在 ≤ 3 年和从基于 TDF 的方案转换后 ≤ 1 年内具有良好的耐受性。试验注册 ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03547908(首次注册 2018-05-24)。

papers.title: NGS-diagnosed HBV encephalitis with isolated left parietal lobe involvement: a case report
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Viral encephalitis refers to the inflammation of the brain parenchyma caused by viral infection, usually manifested as fever, unconsciousness, seizures, and meningeal irritation symptoms. The non-specific clinical manifestations, combined with incomplete medical history, often lead to missed diagnoses and inappropriate treatments. Case presentation We present a case of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) encephalitis, manifesting as isolated left parietal lobe involvement. The patient is a chronic hepatitis B virus carrier who did not receive antiviral therapy. Upon onset, the main symptoms were unconsciousness, fever, and seizures. He was diagnosed with HBV encephalitis thru next-generation sequencing (NGS) testing of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). After antiviral treatment with entecavir and general symptomatic treatment, the patient’s clinical symptoms disappeared, and a follow-up brain MRI showed that the lesion had almost completely resolved. Conclusions Central nervous system (CNS) infections caused by HBV are incredibly uncommon in clinical practice. This case highlights that the clinical manifestations of HBV encephalitis are nonspecific and prone to being missed, while neuroimaging often reveals an isolated lesion. Early application of NGS for accurate pathogen diagnosis is crucial to reduce misdiagnosis.

papers.title: High Rates of Advanced Chronic Liver Disease in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection in Uzbekistan
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is endemic in Uzbekistan. Previous data showed a high prevalence of anti‐hepatitis D virus (HDV) antibodies in HBsAg‐positive individuals. Limited data are available on disease severity, treatment availability and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in patients with chronic HDV infection in Uzbekistan. Methods The Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV) is the leading medical and scientific reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan. In this retrospective study, epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed from all HBsAg‐positive patients presenting to the SRIoV between June 2023 and May 2024. Data from HDV‐coinfected and HBV‐monoinfected patients were compared. Results Data of 1393 individual patients were included. HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV‐monoinfection (73.9% [ n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [ n = 363/1393]. HDV‐infected patients were significantly younger (41.9 vs. 45.4, p < 0.001) and showed higher rates of cirrhosis (78.4% vs. 43.9%, p < 0.001) with the majority of patients being classified as Child–Pugh score B (57.8%). Only a minority of HDV‐coinfected patients has ever received anti‐HDV‐directed treatment (0.4%, n = 4/1030). Consecutively, HDV RNA was detectable in 78.9% (812/1023) of patients. Quantitative HDV RNA was independently associated with ALT elevation > upper limit of normal. The HCC detection rate was low in both patient groups due to insufficient screening measures (HDV: n = 7/1030, HBV: n = 11/363). Conclusions In this retrospective cohort of 1393 individual patients, HDV coinfection exceeds HBV monoinfection in prevalence and disease severity. Most HDV‐infected patients present with advanced liver disease and currently lack access to HDV‐directed therapy.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景和目的 慢性乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染在乌兹别克斯坦流行。先前的数据显示,HBsAg 阳性个体中抗丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 抗体的患病率很高。关于乌兹别克斯坦慢性 HDV 感染患者的疾病严重程度、治疗可用性和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患病率的数据有限。方法 病毒学科学研究所 (SRIOV) 是乌兹别克斯坦领先的病毒性肝炎医学和科学参考中心。在这项回顾性研究中,收集并分析了 2023 年 6 月至 2024 年 5 月期间所有就诊于 SRIoV 的 HBsAg 阳性患者的流行病学、临床和实验室数据。比较了 HDV 合并感染和 HBV 单一感染患者的数据。结果 纳入 1393 名患者的数据。HDV 合并感染比 HBV 单一感染更为普遍 (73.9% [ n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [ n = 363/1393]。HDV 感染患者明显更年轻(41.9 vs. 45.4,p < 0.001),肝硬化发生率较高(78.4% vs. 43.9%,p < 0.001),大多数患者被归类为 Child-Pugh 评分 B(57.8%)。只有少数 HDV 合并感染患者曾接受过抗 HDV 定向治疗(0.4%,n = 4/1030)。连续地,78.9% (812/1023) 的患者可检测到 HDV RNA。HDV RNA 定量与 ALT 升高>正常上限独立相关。由于筛查措施不足,两个患者组的 HCC 检出率均较低(HDV:n = 7/1030,HBV:n = 11/363)。结论 在这个由 1393 名患者组成的回顾性队列中,HDV 合并感染的患病率和疾病严重程度超过了 HBV 单一感染。大多数丁型肝炎病毒感染患者均患有晚期肝病,目前缺乏针对丁型肝炎病毒的治疗。

papers.title: HBcAg-Induced IL-17F drives liver fibrosis in occult HBV infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT While occult hepatitis B virus infection is a known risk factor for progressive liver diseases, the mechanistic basis for this association is poorly understood. To investigate this, we conducted a comparative study involving 40 OBI blood donors and 100 healthy blood donors to assess clinical parameters of liver fibrosis, including serum biomarkers, the FIB-4 index, and liver stiffness measurement. Transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from these donors identified IL-17F as significantly upregulated in the OBI group. Mechanistically, we found that IL-17F was chiefly secreted by CD4 + T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and functionally promoted the expression of key fibrosis-related cytokines and markers. Collectively, our study unveils a novel pathway wherein HBcAg induces CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn accelerates liver fibrogenesis, providing a mechanistic basis for OBI-associated liver disease. IMPORTANCE This study reveals, for the first time, a novel mechanism by which OBI drives liver fibrosis, demonstrating that HBcAg stimulates CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn activates macrophages and hepatic stellate cells, thereby promoting liver inflammation and fibrosis. This discovery not only elucidates a key molecular pathway underlying OBI-related liver disease progression, but also provides an important theoretical foundation for developing IL-17F-targeted diagnostic approaches and anti-fibrotic therapies.

source_records.abstract: ABSTRACT While occult hepatitis B virus infection is a known risk factor for progressive liver diseases, the mechanistic basis for this association is poorly understood. To investigate this, we conducted a comparative study involving 40 OBI blood donors and 100 healthy blood donors to assess clinical parameters of liver fibrosis, including serum biomarkers, the FIB-4 index, and liver stiffness measurement. Transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from these donors identified IL-17F as significantly upregulated in the OBI group. Mechanistically, we found that IL-17F was chiefly secreted by CD4 + T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and functionally promoted the expression of key fibrosis-related cytokines and markers. Collectively, our study unveils a novel pathway wherein HBcAg induces CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn accelerates liver fibrogenesis, providing a mechanistic basis for OBI-associated liver disease. IMPORTANCE This study reveals, for the first time, a novel mechanism by which OBI drives liver fibrosis, demonstrating that HBcAg stimulates CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn activates macrophages and hepatic stellate cells, thereby promoting liver inflammation and fibrosis. This discovery not only elucidates a key molecular pathway underlying OBI-related liver disease progression, but also provides an important theoretical foundation for developing IL-17F-targeted diagnostic approaches and anti-fibrotic therapies.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 虽然隐匿性乙型肝炎病毒感染是进行性肝病的已知危险因素,但人们对这种关联的机制基础知之甚少。为了调查这一点,我们进行了一项比较研究,涉及 40 名 OBI 献血者和 100 名健康献血者,以评估肝纤维化的临床参数,包括血清生物标志物、FIB-4 指数和肝脏硬度测量。对这些供体的外周血单核细胞进行转录组测序,发现 OBI 组中 IL-17F 显着上调。从机制上讲,我们发现 IL-17F 主要由 CD4 + T 细胞在 HBcAg 刺激后分泌,并在功能上促进关键纤维化相关细胞因子和标志物的表达。总的来说,我们的研究揭示了一种新途径,其中 HBcAg 诱导 CD4 + T 细胞分泌 IL-17F,进而加速肝纤维形成,为 OBI 相关肝病提供机制基础。重要性 这项研究首次揭示了 OBI 驱动肝纤维化的新机制,证明 HBcAg 刺激 CD4+T 细胞分泌 IL-17F,进而激活巨噬细胞和肝星状细胞,从而促进肝脏炎症和纤维化。这一发现不仅阐明了OBI相关肝病进展的关键分子通路,而且为开发IL-17F靶向诊断方法和抗纤维化治疗提供了重要的理论基础。

papers.title: Hepatitis B virus in Pakistan: serological marker prevalence, clinical correlates, and genotype-informed interpretation
papers.abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major contributor to chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Pakistan is considered an intermediate-burden country with heterogeneous regional prevalence and genotype distribution. This study summarizes clinical, demographic, serological, and treatment-related patterns in a Pakistani HBV dataset and interprets the findings in the context of known genotype distribution in Pakistan. De-identified electronic health-record data were reviewed for age, gender, body mass index (BMI), disease duration, smoking status, treatment response, adverse effects, and HBV markers, including hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg), hepatitis B e antibody (HBeAb), hepatitis B core immunoglobulin M (HBc IgM), and hepatitis B surface antibody (HBsAb). Descriptive analysis showed a mean age of 45.3 years, near-balanced gender distribution, mean BMI of 27.5 kg/m2, and mean disease duration of 12.7 years. Smoking was reported in 35% of the study population. HBsAg positivity was 1.85%, whereas HBeAg positivity was 21.62%, suggesting an important active-replication subgroup among those tested. HBeAb and HBsAb positivity were each 18.92%, and HBc IgM positivity was 13.51%, indicating a mixture of immune, active, and recent-infection signals. Correlation analysis highlighted strong relationships between age and age of onset, and between weight and BMI. Systemic antiviral care showed a modestly higher mean response score than supportive/local care, while most adverse effects were mild or moderate. These findings underscore the need for improved vaccination, early diagnosis, confirmatory molecular testing, genotype-aware surveillance, and long-term management of chronic HBV in Pakistan.

papers.title_zh: 巴基斯坦乙型肝炎病毒:血清学标志物流行率、临床相关性和基因型解释
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major contributor to chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Pakistan is considered an intermediate-burden country with heterogeneous regional prevalence and genotype distribution. This study summarizes clinical, demographic, serological, and treatment-related patterns in a Pakistani HBV dataset and interprets the findings in the context of known genotype distribution in Pakistan. De-identified electronic health-record data were reviewed for age, gender, body mass index (BMI), disease duration, smoking status, treatment response, adverse effects, and HBV markers, including hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg), hepatitis B e antibody (HBeAb), hepatitis B core immunoglobulin M (HBc IgM), and hepatitis B surface antibody (HBsAb). Descriptive analysis showed a mean age of 45.3 years, near-balanced gender distribution, mean BMI of 27.5 kg/m2, and mean disease duration of 12.7 years. Smoking was reported in 35% of the study population. HBsAg positivity was 1.85%, whereas HBeAg positivity was 21.62%, suggesting an important active-replication subgroup among those tested. HBeAb and HBsAb positivity were each 18.92%, and HBc IgM positivity was 13.51%, indicating a mixture of immune, active, and recent-infection signals. Correlation analysis highlighted strong relationships between age and age of onset, and between weight and BMI. Systemic antiviral care showed a modestly higher mean response score than supportive/local care, while most adverse effects were mild or moderate. These findings underscore the need for improved vaccination, early diagnosis, confirmatory molecular testing, genotype-aware surveillance, and long-term management of chronic HBV in Pakistan.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)仍然是慢性肝病、肝硬化和肝细胞癌的主要致病因素。巴基斯坦被认为是一个中等负担国家,其地区患病率和基因型分布存在差异。本研究总结了巴基斯坦 HBV 数据集中的临床、人口统计学、血清学和治疗相关模式,并在巴基斯坦已知基因型分布的背景下解释了这些发现。对去识别化的电子健康记录数据进行了年龄、性别、体重指数 (BMI)、病程、吸烟状况、治疗反应、不良反应和 HBV 标志物的审查,包括乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg)、乙型肝炎 e 抗原 (HBeAg)、乙型肝炎 e 抗体 (HBeAb)、乙型肝炎核心免疫球蛋白 M (HBc IgM) 和乙型肝炎表面抗体 (HBsAb)。描述性分析显示,平均年龄为 45.3 岁,性别分布接近平衡,平均 BMI 为 27.5 kg/m2,平均病程为 12.7 年。据报告,35% 的研究人群吸烟。HBsAg 阳性率为 1.85%,而 HBeAg 阳性率为 21.62%,表明测试者中有一个重要的活跃复制亚组。HBeAb 和 HBsAb 阳性率分别为 18.92%,HBc IgM 阳性率为 13.51%,表明免疫、活跃和近期感染信号的混合。相关分析强调了年龄与发病年龄、体重与体重指数之间的密切关系。全身抗病毒治疗的平均反应评分略高于支持性/局部治疗,而大多数不良反应为轻度或中度。这些发现强调了巴基斯坦需要改进疫苗接种、早期诊断、确认性分子检测、基因型监测和长期管理慢性乙型肝炎。

papers.title: Recombinant polyclonal antibody GIGA-2339 potently and pan-genotypically neutralizes hepatitis B virus.
papers.abstract: Existing hepatitis B virus (HBV) treatments control viral replication in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients but fail to prevent hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) production; excessive HBsAg production leads to HBV-specific immune tolerance. GIGA-2339 is a first-in-class, recombinant polyclonal antibody (pAb) therapeutic consisting of over 1,000 human IgG1/IgK antibodies targeting HBsAg epitopes developed for the treatment of chronic HBV infection. As Hepatitis D virus (HDV) utilizes HBsAg produced by HBV for viral entry, GIGA-2339 may also provide benefit to HDV/HBV co-infected patients. Memory B cells from HBV vaccinated donors were isolated and HBsAg-specific antibody sequences were enriched using GigaGen's single cell microfluidic antibody capture platform. Full-length antibody sequences targeting HBsAg were cloned and transfected en masse using a targeted integration Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell line, followed by bulk expression and purification. In vitro, GIGA-2339 bound HBsAg and neutralized live HBV with over 2,000-fold greater potency than a plasma-based hepatitis B immunoglobulin hyperimmune (HyperHEP B) and slightly lower potency than a HBsAg monoclonal antibody (mAb). GIGA-2339 neutralized pan-genotypic HBsAg (A-H) enveloped viral particles, bound clinically significant HBsAg escape mutants, and engaged human Fc receptors on immune cells. In vivo studies showed improved reduction of circulating HBsAg in a chronic stage as compared to HyperHEP B. The novel polyclonal antibody therapeutic GIGA-2339 potently binds and neutralizes HBsAg to prevent viral infection and to reduce circulating antigen. GIGA-2339 represents an important new therapeutic modality for the CHB treatment landscape and is currently in clinical development.

papers.abstract_zh: 现有的乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)治疗可以控制慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者的病毒复制,但无法阻止乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)的产生;过量的 HBsAg 产生会导致 HBV 特异性免疫耐受。GIGA-2339 是一种一流的重组多克隆抗体 (pAb) 治疗药物,由 1,000 多种针对 HBsAg 表位的人 IgG1/IgK 抗体组成,专为治疗慢性 HBV 感染而开发。由于丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 利用 HBV 产生的 HBsAg 进行病毒侵入,因此 GIGA-2339 也可能为 HDV/HBV 共感染患者带来益处。使用 GigaGen 的单细胞微流控抗体捕获平台,分离了来自 HBV 疫苗接种者的记忆 B 细胞,并富集了 HBsAg 特异性抗体序列。使用靶向整合中国仓鼠卵巢 (CHO) 细胞系克隆并集体转染针对 HBsAg 的全长抗体序列,然后进行批量表达和纯化。在体外,GIGA-2339 结合 HBsAg 并中和活 HBV,其效力比基于血浆的乙型肝炎免疫球蛋白超免疫 (HyperHEP B) 高 2,000 倍,但比 HBsAg 单克隆抗体 (mAb) 的效力略低。GIGA-2339 中和全基因型 HBsAg (A-H) 包膜病毒颗粒,结合具有临床意义的 HBsAg 逃逸突变体,并与免疫细胞上的人类 Fc 受体结合。体内研究表明,与 HyperHEP B 相比,慢性阶段循环 HBsAg 的减少有所改善。新型多克隆抗体治疗剂 GIGA-2339 有效结合并中和 HBsAg,以预防病毒感染并减少循环抗原。GIGA-2339代表了慢性乙型肝炎治疗领域的一种重要的新治疗方式,目前正处于临床开发阶段。

papers.title: Long-term incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma after hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) decreases following hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance. We examined HCC incidence in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) who cleared HBsAg compared to general population. METHODS: All adults with CHB who cleared HBsAg between 2000-2022 were identified using a territory-wide database in Hong Kong. Annual HCC incidences were estimated and compared to general population. Age- and sex-specific population statistics were retrieved from the Hong Kong Cancer Registry and Census and Statistics Department. RESULTS: Of 13,379 patients with HBsAg seroclearance (mean age 59.7±13.7 years, 59.8% males, 14.6% cirrhosis), 274 (2.0%) developed HCC at a median of 5.6 (IQR 3.1-9.8) years. Annual HCC incidence (95% CI) was 0.43% (0.22%-0.73%) and 0.62% (0.50%-0.76%) among patients with cirrhosis aged <50 years and ≥50 years at HBsAg seroclearance, respectively. In patients without cirrhosis who cleared HBsAg before age 50, the annual HCC incidence was 0.03% (95% CI 0.01%-0.06%), comparable to 0.03% in general population. Annual HCC incidence of male patients without cirrhosis aged <40 and 40-49 years at HBsAg was 0.02% (95% CI 0.002%-0.08%) and 0.09% (0.03%-0.19%), respectively. No HCC cases occurred during 15 years of follow-up among 1,317 female patients without cirrhosis aged <50 years at HBsAg loss; the annual HCC incidence was 0.06% (95% CI 0.02%-0.13%) among those aged 50-59 years. CONCLUSIONS: Patients with CHB who clear HBsAg at younger ages, particularly men <40 years and women <50 years without cirrhosis or additional risk factors, have very low HCC risk and may not require routine surveillance.

The study addressed whether HBsAg seroclearance reduces HCC incidence and identified patient subgroups where surveillance may be unnecessary.

The cohort included 13,379 patients with a mean age of 59.7±13.7 years, 59.8% males, and 14.6% with cirrhosis.
analysis.methods: Patients with CHB who cleared HBsAg were identified from a territory-wide database in Hong Kong. Age- and sex-specific population statistics were retrieved from the Hong Kong Cancer Registry and Census and Statistics Department to estimate annual HCC incidence.
analysis.main_results: Among 13,379 patients with HBsAg seroclearance, 274 (2.0%) developed HCC at a median of 5.6 years (IQR 3.1–9.8). Annual HCC incidence was 0.43% (95% CI 0.22%–0.73%) and 0.62% (95% CI 0.50%–0.76%) in patients with cirrhosis aged <50 and ≥50 years, respectively.

analysis.summary_en: This territory-wide cohort study in Hong Kong evaluated the long-term incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) after hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance in 13,379 adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). papers.abstract_zh: 背景和目的:乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)血清清除后,肝细胞癌(HCC)的风险降低。我们比较了清除 HBsAg 的慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者与普通人群的 HCC 发病率。方法:使用香港全港数据库对 2000 年至 2022 年期间清除 HBsAg 的所有慢性乙型肝炎成人进行识别。估算年度 HCC 发病率并与一般人群进行比较。特定年龄和性别的人口统计数据取自香港癌症登记处和政府统计处。结果:在 13,379 名 HBsAg 血清清除患者中(平均年龄 59.7±13.7 岁,59.8% 男性,14.6% 肝硬化),274 名 (2.0%) 患者在中位 5.6 (IQR 3.1-9.8) 岁时发展为 HCC。HBsAg 血清清除时年龄<50 岁和≥50 岁的肝硬化患者的年 HCC 发病率 (95% CI) 分别为 0.43% (0.22%-0.73%) 和 0.62% (0.50%-0.76%)。在 50 岁之前清除 HBsAg 的无肝硬化患者中,年 HCC 发病率为 0.03%(95% CI 0.01%-0.06%),与普通人群的 0.03% 相当。HBsAg 检测结果显示,年龄 <40 岁和 40-49 岁的无肝硬化男性患者的 HCC 年发病率分别为 0.02%(95% CI 0.002%-0.08%)和 0.09%(0.03%-0.19%)。对 1,317 名年龄 <50 岁且 HBsAg 消失的无肝硬化女性患者进行 15 年随访期间,没有发生 HCC 病例;50-59岁人群中HCC年发病率为0.06%(95% CI 0.02%-0.13%)。结论:在较年轻时清除 HBsAg 的慢性乙型肝炎患者,特别是没有肝硬化或其他危险因素的 40 岁以下男性和 50 岁以下女性,HCC 风险非常低,可能不需要常规监测。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)仍然是肝细胞癌(HCC)的主要危险因素,但乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)血清清除后的长期风险尚不确定。该研究探讨了 HBsAg 血清清除是否会降低 HCC 发病率,并确定了可能不需要监测的患者亚组。

analysis_zh.methods: HBsAg 清除的慢性乙型肝炎患者是从香港全港数据库中确定的。从香港癌症登记处和政府统计处检索特定年龄和性别的人口统计数据,以估计每年的肝癌发病率。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 13,379 名 HBsAg 血清学清除的患者中,274 名 (2.0%) 人在中位 5.6 年时发展为 HCC (IQR 3.1-9.8)。年龄<50岁和≥50岁的肝硬化患者的HCC年发病率分别为0.43%(95% CI 0.22%–0.73%)和0.62%(95% CI 0.50%–0.76%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,在较年轻的时候清除 HBsAg 的患者,特别是没有肝硬化或其他危险因素的 40 岁以下男性和 50 岁以下女性,肝癌风险非常低。这表明在这些亚组中可能没有必要进行常规 HCC 监测。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持对实现 HBsAg 血清学清除的慢性乙型肝炎患者采取风险分层 HCC 监测策略,有可能减少不必要的医疗负担和成本,同时保持安全性。

papers.title: Safety and efficacy of libevitug in patients with chronic hepatitis B and D virus coinfection: A single-center, open-label, phase IIa trial in China
papers.abstract: Background: Chronic HBV and HDV coinfection represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis. This study aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of libevitug (HH-003), a novel human monoclonal antibody targeting the PreS1 domain of the HBV large envelope protein, in patients with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection. Methods: This single-center, open-label, proof-of-concept phase IIa clinical trial enrolled 9 participants who received i.v. infusion of 20 mg/kg libevitug every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, followed by a 24-week follow-up period. Results: At week 24, 8 participants (88.9%) exhibited a reduction in HDV RNA ≥1 log 10 from baseline, with 4 (44.4%) achieving undetectable levels. 7 participants (77.8%) achieved virological response (undetectable HDV RNA or ≥2 log 10 decline from baseline). Among the 5 participants with elevated baseline ALT, 3 (60.0%) achieved a combined virological and biochemical response (ALT normalization). At week 48, 6 participants (66.7%) maintained the virological response achieved at the end of treatment (week 24), with 3 (33.3%) maintaining undetectable HDV RNA levels. Among the 7 participants with quantifiable HBV DNA at baseline, 2 (28.6%) achieved undetectable HBV DNA or ≥1 log 10 reduction at week 24. Serum HBsAg levels remained unchanged throughout the study period. Treatment-emergent adverse events were reported in 8 participants (88.9%), with only 1 participant (11.1%) experiencing treatment-related adverse events. No grade 3 or serious adverse events were reported, and no discontinuations due to adverse events occurred. Conclusions: Libevitug demonstrated promising antiviral activity, achieving substantial HDV RNA reduction, a high rate of ALT normalization, and favorable safety and tolerability in participants with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B and D virus coinfection represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis, and effective therapies remain limited. The study aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of libevitug, a novel human monoclonal antibody targeting the PreS1 domain of the HBV large envelope protein, in this patient population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a single-center, open-label, phase IIa clinical trial conducted in China that enrolled 9 participants with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection. Participants received intravenous infusion of 20 mg/kg libevitug every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, followed by a 24-week follow-up period.
analysis.methods: The trial administered libevitug at a dose of 20 mg/kg intravenously every 2 weeks for 24 weeks with a subsequent 24-week follow-up. Safety was monitored throughout the study period, and virological and biochemical responses were assessed at predefined intervals.
analysis.main_results: At week 24, 8 participants (88.9%) showed a reduction in HDV RNA of at least 1 log10 from baseline, with 4 (44.4%) achieving undetectable levels. Seven participants (77.8%) achieved a virological response, defined as undetectable HDV RNA or a ≥2 log10 decline from baseline. Among those with elevated baseline ALT, 3 of 5 (60.0%) achieved combined virological and biochemical response. At week 48, 6 participants (66.7%) maintained virological response, with 3 (33.3%) maintaining undetectable HDV RNA. Serum HBsAg levels remained unchanged, and among 7 participants with quantifiable HBV DNA at baseline, 2 (28.6%) achieved undetectable HBV DNA or ≥1 log10 reduction at week 24.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted libevitug as demonstrating promising antiviral activity with substantial HDV RNA reduction, a high rate of ALT normalization, and favorable safety and tolerability in this small cohort. The novelty lies in the first-in-human evaluation of libevitug targeting the PreS1 domain for HBV/HDV coinfection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings cautiously suggest potential for libevitug as an adjunctive therapy in chronic HBV/HDV coinfection, particularly for HDV suppression and ALT normalization, warranting further investigation in larger, controlled trials.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The small sample size (n=9), single-center design, and open-label structure limit generalizability and introduce potential bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of a control group and short follow-up period.

analysis.summary_en: This single-center, open-label phase IIa trial evaluated libevitug, a novel anti-HBV monoclonal antibody targeting the PreS1 domain, in 9 patients with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection. Over 24 weeks of treatment with 20 mg/kg libevitug every 2 weeks, 88.9% of participants achieved at least a 1 log10 reduction in HDV RNA, with 44.4% achieving undetectable levels. Virological response (≥2 log10 decline or undetectable HDV RNA) was observed in 77.8%, and 60.0% of those with elevated baseline ALT achieved combined virological and biochemical response. At week 48, 66.7% maintained virological response, though only 33.3% retained undetectable HDV RNA. HBV DNA suppression occurred in 28.6% of those with quantifiable baseline levels, while HBsAg remained unchanged. papers.title_zh: libevitug 在慢性乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎病毒合并感染患者中的安全性和有效性:中国的单中心、开放标签、IIa 期试验
papers.source_body_en: Background: Chronic HBV and HDV coinfection represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis. This study aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of libevitug (HH-003), a novel human monoclonal antibody targeting the PreS1 domain of the HBV large envelope protein, in patients with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection. Methods: This single-center, open-label, proof-of-concept phase IIa clinical trial enrolled 9 participants who received i.v. infusion of 20 mg/kg libevitug every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, followed by a 24-week follow-up period. Results: At week 24, 8 participants (88.9%) exhibited a reduction in HDV RNA ≥1 log 10 from baseline, with 4 (44.4%) achieving undetectable levels. 7 participants (77.8%) achieved virological response (undetectable HDV RNA or ≥2 log 10 decline from baseline). Among the 5 participants with elevated baseline ALT, 3 (60.0%) achieved a combined virological and biochemical response (ALT normalization). At week 48, 6 participants (66.7%) maintained the virological response achieved at the end of treatment (week 24), with 3 (33.3%) maintaining undetectable HDV RNA levels. Among the 7 participants with quantifiable HBV DNA at baseline, 2 (28.6%) achieved undetectable HBV DNA or ≥1 log 10 reduction at week 24. Serum HBsAg levels remained unchanged throughout the study period. Treatment-emergent adverse events were reported in 8 participants (88.9%), with only 1 participant (11.1%) experiencing treatment-related adverse events. No grade 3 or serious adverse events were reported, and no discontinuations due to adverse events occurred. Conclusions: Libevitug demonstrated promising antiviral activity, achieving substantial HDV RNA reduction, a high rate of ALT normalization, and favorable safety and tolerability in participants with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎病毒合并感染是最严重的病毒性肝炎,有效的治疗方法仍然有限。该研究旨在评估 libevitug(一种针对 HBV 大包膜蛋白 PreS1 结构域的新型人单克隆抗体)在该患者群体中的安全性和有效性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项在中国进行的单中心、开放标签、IIa期临床试验,共纳入9名慢性乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)与丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)合并感染患者。受试者接受为期24周、每2周静脉输注20 mg/kg libevitug的治疗,随后进行24周的随访期。
analysis_zh.methods: 该试验以 20 mg/kg 的剂量每 2 周静脉注射一次 libevitug,持续 24 周,并随后进行 24 周的随访。在整个研究期间监测安全性,并按预定时间间隔评估病毒学和生化反应。
analysis_zh.main_results: 第 24 周时,8 名参与者 (88.9%) 的 HDV RNA 较基线减少至少 1 log10,其中 4 名参与者 (44.4%) 达到不可检测的水平。七名参与者 (77.8%) 达到了病毒学应答,定义为无法检测到 HDV RNA 或较基线下降 ≥2 log10。在基线 ALT 升高的患者中,5 人中有 3 人 (60.0%) 实现了病毒学和生化综合反应。第 48 周时,6 名参与者 (66.7%) 保持病毒学应答,其中 3 名参与者 (33.3%) 保持检测不到 HDV RNA。血清 HBsAg 水平保持不变,在 7 名基线时具有可量化 HBV DNA 的参与者中,2 名 (28.6%) 在第 24 周时达到了不可检测的 HBV DNA 或≥1 log10 降低。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 libevitug 解释为在这个小队列中表现出有希望的抗病毒活性,同时 HDV RNA 大幅减少、ALT 正常化率高、以及良好的安全性和耐受性。新颖之处在于针对 HBV/HDV 合并感染的 PreS1 结构域的 libevitug 的首次人体评估。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现谨慎地表明 libevitug 作为慢性 HBV/HDV 合并感染的辅助治疗的潜力,特别是对于 HDV 抑制和 ALT 正常化,需要在更大规模的对照试验中进行进一步研究。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 小样本量(n = 9)、单中心设计和开放标签结构限制了普遍性并引入了潜在的偏差。由于缺乏对照组且随访期短,证据强度中等。

papers.title: AURKA regulates HBV-induced hepatic stellate cell inflammation and liver fibrosis by modulating K48-linked ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of TLR3
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB), caused by persistent hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, continues to pose a major global health threat. Aurora kinase A (AURKA) has been implicated in fibrosis, yet its role in HBV-induced liver fibrosis remains unclear. This study investigated the function and mechanism of AURKA in hepatic stellate cell (HSC) activation and fibrogenesis during CHB. Bioinformatics screening of GSE83148 dataset and validation in human CHB liver specimens, LX-2 HSCs treated with conditioned medium (CM) from HBV-replicating cells, and a persistent HBV recombinant cccDNA (rcccDNA) mouse model established by tail-vein injection of Ad/rcccDNA were performed. Gene and protein expression was analyzed by quantitative PCR and immunoblotting, respectively. Cytokine levels were measured by ELISA. Mitochondrial function was assessed via ROS and JC-1 assays. Protein interactions and ubiquitination were evaluated by co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) and protein stability assays. In additional experiments, LX-2 cells were stimulated with purified HBV virions at varying MOIs to assess direct viral effects. AURKA was significantly upregulated in CHB patients and HBV-CM-treated LX-2 HSCs. In LX-2 HSCs, AURKA knockdown attenuated HBV-CM-induced inflammatory cytokine secretion (IL‐1β, IL‐6), mitochondrial dysfunction (mitochondrial ROS, mitochondrial membrane potential), HSC proliferation, and fibrotic marker expression (COL I, α-SMA). Mechanistically, AURKA interacted with TLR3 and was associated with its K48-linked polyubiquitination and degradation. TLR3 silencing abolished the protective effects of AURKA knockdown. In vivo, using a persistent HBV rcccDNA mouse model, AURKA knockdown ameliorated HBV-induced hepatic inflammation and fibrosis by upregulating TLR3. Notably, purified HBV virions alone were sufficient to dose-dependently induce AURKA expression and downstream fibrotic responses in HSCs. This study identifies a novel AURKA/TLR3 axis that regulates HBV-induced HSC activation and liver fibrosis, positioning AURKA as a potential therapeutic target for CHB-associated fibrosis.

papers.abstract_zh: 由持续乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染引起的慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)继续对全球健康构成重大威胁。极光激酶 A (AURKA) 与纤维化有关,但其在 HBV 诱导的肝纤维化中的作用仍不清楚。本研究探讨了 AURKA 在 CHB 期间肝星状细胞 (HSC) 激活和纤维形成中的功能和机制。对 GSE83148 数据集进行生物信息学筛选,并在人 CHB 肝脏标本、用来自 HBV 复制细胞的条件培养基 (CM) 处理的 LX-2 HSC 以及通过尾静脉注射 Ad/rcccDNA 建立的持久性 HBV 重组 cccDNA (rcccDNA) 小鼠模型中进行验证。分别通过定量PCR和免疫印迹分析基因和蛋白质表达。通过ELISA测量细胞因子水平。通过 ROS 和 JC-1 测定评估线粒体功能。通过免疫共沉淀 (Co-IP) 和蛋白质稳定性测定评估蛋白质相互作用和泛素化。在其他实验中,用纯化的 HBV 病毒粒子以不同的 MOI 刺激 LX-2 细胞,以评估直接病毒效应。AURKA 在 CHB 患者和 HBV-CM 治疗的 LX-2 HSC 中显着上调。在 LX-2 HSC 中,AURKA 敲低减弱了 HBV-CM 诱导的炎症细胞因子分泌(IL-1β、IL-6)、线粒体功能障碍(线粒体 ROS、线粒体膜电位)、HSC 增殖和纤维化标志物表达(COL I、α-SMA)。从机制上讲,AURKA 与 TLR3 相互作用,并与其 K48 连接的多聚泛素化和降解相关。TLR3 沉默消除了 AURKA 敲低的保护作用。在体内,使用持续性 HBV rcccDNA 小鼠模型,AURKA 敲低通过上调 TLR3 改善 HBV 诱导的肝脏炎症和纤维化。值得注意的是,单独纯化的 HBV 病毒体足以剂量依赖性地诱导 HSC 中的 AURKA 表达和下游纤维化反应。这项研究确定了一个新的 AURKA/TLR3 轴,可以调节 HBV 诱导的 HSC 激活和肝纤维化,将 AURKA 定位为 CHB 相关纤维化的潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: Quality of life and self-reported stigma following hepatitis B surface antigen loss: A multi-site study by the Canadian Hepatitis B Network
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) imposes adverse health outcomes but may also cause psychosocial and quality-of-life (QOL) challenges. Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss, whether spontaneous or due to treatment (ie, a functional cure), is associated with improved clinical outcomes, but the impact of HBsAg clearance on patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) is poorly understood. Methods: Two surveys (hepatitis B self-stigma and hepatitis B–related QOL [HBQOL]) were administered to adults with a history of CHB with documented HBsAg clearance from six Canadian hepatology clinics. Results: Eighty-four participants were enrolled (median age: 60 years; 53.6% male). Nearly three quarters (72.6%) of patients reported never feeling self-stigma. HBQOL scores improved across all six domains ( p < 0.001 for each), with the largest relative gains in psychological well-being (60% reduction), transmission concerns (55%), and stigma (53%). Conclusions: HBsAg loss was associated with significant improvements in patient-reported stigma and QOL. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating PROMs into hepatitis B virus clinical care to better capture treatment experiences.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) imposes adverse health outcomes and psychosocial challenges, but the impact of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss on patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) such as quality of life (QOL) and self-stigma remains poorly understood despite its association with improved clinical outcomes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A multi-site study was conducted across six Canadian hepatology clinics, enrolling adults with documented HBsAg clearance to assess PROMs following HBsAg loss.
analysis.methods: Two surveys were administered: one measuring hepatitis B self-stigma and another assessing hepatitis B–related quality of life (HBQOL), with participants drawn from clinics where HBsAg clearance had been documented.
analysis.main_results: Among 84 participants (median age: 60 years), nearly three quarters (72.6%) reported never experiencing self-stigma, and HBQOL scores improved significantly across all six domains (p < 0.001 for each), with the largest relative gains in psychological well-being (60% reduction), transmission concerns (55%), and stigma (53%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence that HBsAg loss is associated with substantial improvements in patient-reported stigma and quality of life, highlighting a novel focus on PROMs in hepatitis B clinical care.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results suggest that incorporating PROMs into hepatitis B clinical care could better capture treatment experiences and patient well-being, informing patient-centered care strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on abstract-only evidence, lack of a control group, and potential selection bias due to clinic-based recruitment, warranting cautious interpretation of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This multi-site Canadian study assessed patient-reported outcomes following hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss in adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Among 84 participants, 72.6% reported never experiencing self-stigma, and significant improvements were observed in all six domains of hepatitis B–related quality of life (HBQOL), particularly in psychological well-being (60% reduction), transmission concerns (55%), and stigma (53%). The authors conclude that HBsAg loss is associated with meaningful gains in patient-reported stigma and quality of life, emphasizing the importance of integrating PROMs into hepatitis B clinical care. However, the evidence is limited to abstract-level data, lacks a control group, and may be subject to selection bias, reducing the strength of the conclusions.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景:慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 会带来不良的健康结果,但也可能导致心理社会和生活质量 (QOL) 挑战。乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 丧失,无论是自发的还是由于治疗(即功能性治愈)导致的,都与临床结果的改善相关,但 HBsAg 清除率对患者报告的结果测量 (PROM) 的影响知之甚少。方法:对有慢性乙型肝炎病史且有来自加拿大六个肝病诊所的 HBsAg 清除记录的成年人进行两项调查(乙型肝炎自我污名和乙型肝炎相关生活质量 [HBQOL])。结果:共有 84 名参与者入组(中位年龄:60 岁;53.6% 为男性)。近四分之三(72.6%)的患者表示从未感到自我耻辱。所有六个领域的 HBQOL 分数均有所改善(每个领域 p < 0.001),其中心理健康(减少 60%)、传播担忧(55%)和耻辱(53%)方面的相对收益最大。结论:HBsAg 消失与患者报告的耻辱感和生活质量的显着改善相关。这些发现强调了将 PROM 纳入乙型肝炎病毒临床护理以更好地获取治疗经验的重要性。
